validity.recommendation: Keep StartCountryOrArea=Turkmenistan / EndCountryOrArea=India (the full 4-country TAPI project as designed); add a RouteNotes/ResearcherNotes caveat that the digitized geometry is a partial trace covering only the Turkmenistan-Afghanistan corridor (ending near Kandahar, Afghanistan) and does not yet extend across the unbuilt Pakistan and India legs. The Afghan endpoint sits on the real, sourced route corridor, not a digitizing error, so do not relocate it or treat RouteAccuracy=medium as wrong on this basis. A human should decide whether to source/add Pakistan+India geometry once available, or annotate the row as a partial route pending those legs.
validity.researcher_notes: Per Tolqun News (2024-09-11), TAPI's Afghan section is 816 km and passes through 'the provinces of Herat, Farah, Nimroz, Helmand and Kandahar' -- Kandahar city sits at approx. 31.6N/65.7E, matching the row's drawn last endpoint (31.717, 65.715) almost exactly. So the endpoint is a legitimate point along the planned/sourced Afghan corridor, not a location error. Per Didpress (2026-07-23), actual physical construction to date is confined to Herat province (127 of the province's 153 km prepared, 106 km of pipe laid); construction in Pakistan and India has not started. This matches Status=construction and is the likely explanation for why the digitized geometry stops within Afghanistan (at/near the leading edge of the planned corridor) rather than continuing across Pakistan to the Fazilka, India endpoint the row's own EndLocation/EndCountryOrArea specify -- a granularity/incompleteness artifact (geometry lags the row's full stated extent), not a start/end-column error and not a case for moving the endpoint. Status/ownership/cost already researched elsewhere per brief and not re-litigated here; no new coordinates proposed.
